routes.title: Home
routes.purpose: Pick the organism or organisms you want to work with — there are several ways to find them — or search straight for a gene by its ID.

routes.title: Annotation Search
routes.purpose: Find genes across one or more organisms by what is known about them — a keyword, an annotation term, or an ID.

routes.title: BLAST
routes.purpose: Search genome assemblies by sequence similarity. Paste a DNA or protein sequence, select a program and database, and run.

routes.title: Primer BLAST
routes.purpose: Check primer pairs against a genome and transcriptome: how many products they would amplify, where those land, and how big each one is.

routes.title: Downloads
routes.purpose: Browse and download genome sequence and annotation files for organisms you have access to.

routes.title: Retrieve Sequences
routes.purpose: Look up sequences by feature ID across any accessible assembly. Enter gene or transcript IDs and retrieve genomic, CDS, protein, and flanking sequences.

routes.title: Group page
reached_by: From the home page — choose a curated group of organisms.
From the home page — or build your own selection of organisms.
routes.purpose: Search genes across every organism in a curated group, filtering both the organism list and the results.

routes.title: Organism page
reached_by: From the home page — pick an organism.
routes.purpose: Search genes across all the assemblies and gene sets held for one organism, filtering both the sources searched and the results.

routes.title: Assembly page
reached_by: From an organism page — pick one of its assemblies.
Or search for it by name from the home page.
routes.purpose: Search genes within a single assembly, choosing which of its gene sets to search.

routes.title: Gene set page
reached_by: From an assembly page — pick one of its gene sets.
Or search for it by name from the home page.
routes.purpose: Search genes within a single gene set, filtering the results by annotation source.
